# b15-long-guide-near-limit

## Overview
The review process has four steps. First the author prepares a short description of the change and links the related issue. Second a reviewer reads the description before the code, so they know the intent. Third the reviewer leaves comments that are specific, polite and actionable. Fourth the author answers each comment, either by changing the code or by explaining why not. The review process has four steps.
